verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs claim support for Windows, macOS, Linux, Web, iOS and Android, and a community/maintainer comment says it runs well on iOS, so the desktop and mobile parts of the story are covered. Nothing in the evidence shows console export, either direct or via partners, and that is a core element of the story. Missing for 10: console export (direct or partner-based), detailed export/packaging documentation, independent corroboration of Android and desktop shipping.
